motions.motion_text:
One inquiry was raised by Member S. Desroches
Motorcycle Inquiry
The Ottawa Police Service plays a vital role in ensuring the safety of residents. The OPS also has the unique priority of ensuring the success of ceremonial events and VIP events for the federal government, as the police service for Canada’s capital.
This work is typically performed by the OPS Motorcycle Unit, which requires additional training and resources to support the federal government's security and protocol demands on the streets of Ottawa.
This role is important, but as a service responsible for the safety of the residents in Ottawa, these federal duties should not come with increased expenses and less enforcement for Ottawa taxpayers.
I would like the OPS to answer the following questions to assure that assisting the federal government is not taking away from core policing priorities our residents depend upon each day.
If the number of hours cannot be calculated, identify other measures that can be used to demonstrate the resources dedicated to this work?
